Q&A

Electric (×2), Grass (×2). Resists Fire, Water, Ice, Steel. Calculated from the gen 3 type chart (FireRed/LeafGreen).

Squirtle evolves into Wartortle starting at level 16. Wartortle evolves into Blastoise starting at level 36.

Locations: Pallet Town (100 %, Lv 5). That's all. Squirtle is limited to these spots in FR/LG. See the interactive maps for the full area view.

Our take: Yes. Squirtle beats Brock safely, has solid matchups throughout and grows into a bulky anchor with Surf and Ice Beam coverage.
